owner_roles.accountability: Scope, sequencing, phase acceptance and omission prevention.
Normative KIS patterns, compatibility, governance and deviations.
Actor vocabulary, task clarity, journey completeness and outcome parity.
Production implementation, focused tests and safe removal of replaced code.
Authorization, policy, CSRF, step-up, trust, disclosure, audit and recovery.
WCAG 2.2 AA, semantics, keyboard, focus, motion, zoom, touch and assistive technology.
Installable extension and template contracts, compatibility and conformance.
Fixtures, diagnostics, visual evidence, parity and regression gates.
Production topology, database matrix, backup/restore and release qualification.

severity_policy.definition: Critical task inaccessible, authorization or disclosure risk, destructive ambiguity, unusable supported viewport, missing primary workflow or corruption risk.
Clipping, overlap, unreachable action, serious navigation ambiguity, lost context, broken keyboard operation or materially overwhelming composition.
Consistency, density, terminology, secondary-workflow or recoverable responsive weakness.
Optional polish without meaningful task, accessibility, security or comprehension impact.

evidence_rules.history_policy: Evidence IDs are immutable; a correction appends a record with supersedes rather than replacing history.
evidence_rules.completion_policy: Every evidence ID required by a completed work item or gate must exist and be accepted.

evidence_records.environment: Repository source and supplied graphical audit captures at the recorded base revision.
evidence_records.result: Confirmed portal guest grid, missing icon, Business Definitions component overflow and systemic information-architecture gaps.

continuation_history.notes: Phase 0 programme controls and diagnostics, KIS 1.0 foundations and the reference gallery are active on the shared Phase 0-2 branch. Phase 2 production migrations must not begin before parity manifests and reference component evidence are accepted.

Phase 0-2 source implementation is committed in phase order. Gates A-D remain in review until native PHP/Composer, Chromium behavior/accessibility/visual, database/recovery, security, and accountable human evidence is accepted; Phase 3 must not begin before those gates close.
